# G82 — Every low-dimensional manifold in the wiki is measured, none is generated

**Status:** `PARTIAL`  
**Kind:** `part`  
**Level:** `L3`  
**Registry:** [[wiki/architectural-gaps.md]]  
**Closes when:** A manifold is generated by a stated construction — low-rank connectivity, spectral gap, symmetry breaking or a wiring-rule Laplacian — and the coefficients on that basis are produced by the model rather than fitted after the fact.

## Why it blocks the target

Population geometry is the wiki's standard level of description — manifolds, subspaces, order parameters — and in every case the manifold is recovered *after the fact* by a dimensionality-reduction algorithm run on activity. A structured flow on a manifold requires a generator: a spectral gap at an instability, a low-rank coupling matrix, or a broken symmetry. Without one, a low-dimensional projection is compatible with a structured flow and does not evidence one, so claims that the manifold *does* computation (rather than displaying it) are unsupported — and no architecture here can be built to have a manifold of a specified shape

## Best current answer

Three named candidates, none arbitrated and none implemented: **low-rank connectivity** (rank `r` confines the dynamics to `r` dimensions by construction), **averaging/decorrelation** (the spectral gap of the Fokker–Planck operator, [[wiki/concepts/mean-field-reduction.md]] rung 3), and **symmetry breaking in the reduced space** (Jirsa & Sheheitli — an equivariant system's reduced flow is degenerate; heterogeneous long-range edges break the equivariance). These fix the manifold in the weights, in the statistics, and in the flow respectively, so they are not variants of one story. A fourth, added by Vohryzek et al. 2024: **the anatomical Laplacian spectrum** — take the graph itself as the generator and its low eigenvectors as the manifold's axes, which requires no activity, no instability and no fitting, and is the only one of the four that hands a builder explicit coordinates. A fifth, and the cheapest to implement: **the task sampler's covariance**. Vary a task family's parameter at expectation zero and the subspace that parameter sweeps out becomes the subspace the controller searches in — measured behaviourally as compression of exploration variance orthogonal to it, and as a transfer benefit that cannot be the mean mapping because the mean mapping is the identity by construction (Braun et al. 2009, [[wiki/concepts/structural-learning.md]]). It generates a manifold from a *training statistic* rather than from weights, dynamics or anatomy, which is the only one of the five a machine learner can impose without touching the architecture — and it too stops short of coefficients: the metaparameter `μ` is never read out anywhere, only inferred from error curves and variance ellipses A sixth, and the only one with a biological instance attached: **Turing pattern formation under a continuous weight symmetry** (Khona & Fiete 2022, [[wiki/concepts/attractor-dynamics.md]]). Three conditions are jointly sufficient to generate a stationary continuous-attractor manifold — bounded activity (saturating nonlinearity, or inhibition-dominated recurrence with uniform excitatory drive); local excitation or disinhibition with broader inhibition, strong enough to pattern-form through a linear Turing instability, the formed patterns *being* the attractor states; and a continuous symmetry in the weights, which makes the set a continuum rather than a discrete lattice. The manifold's topology is then the symmetry's, fixed before any data arrive, and the same principle is the one that patterns plant and animal tissue. Two things distinguish it from the five above. It tunes weight **shapes** and leaves magnitudes free, where the line-attractor construction needs feedback magnitude finely matched to decay — so "continuous attractors require fine tuning" is a statement about the linear route only. And it is the only candidate here whose generated manifolds are *identified in tissue* by the criteria in [[wiki/concepts/attractor-identification.md]] (head-direction ring, grid torus). What it still does not supply is this row's second half — the coefficients: how a circuit imposes and maintains a continuous symmetry across neurons is named open in the same review, and the available development models either need uniform exploration of the input space with recurrence suppressed during training, or a loss function no biological account provides.

## From

Hashemi et al. 2025; [[wiki/concepts/structured-flows-on-manifolds.md]]; Vohryzek et al. 2024, [[wiki/concepts/anatomical-harmonic-modes.md]]; Braun et al. 2009, [[wiki/concepts/structural-learning.md]]

## Status

`PARTIAL` — a fourth candidate is now instantiated and it is the only one that produces a *usable basis*: the eigenvectors of a Laplacian built from the wiring rule (exponential distance decay + its rare >3 SD long-range violations), computed in closed form before the system runs, with ~20 of 200 modes carrying the bulk of both spontaneous and 47 task-evoked activity. What it does not close: the coefficients `a_k(t)` get no dynamics, so the basis is generated and the *flow on it* still is not
